description: Trunk: establish authenticated session for cc_manager role QA account (qa-test-comc-manager@phronex.com). Required by journeys that test manager-level RBAC boundaries.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/auth/login. Fill the email field with 'qa-test-comc-manager@phronex.com' and the password field with the value from environment variable PHRONEX_QA_MANAGER_PASSWORD. Submit the form. Wait for redirect. PASS if the browser lands on /command-centre/dashboard (or any authenticated ComC page). FAIL if redirected back to /auth/login (wrong credentials) or if a 500 error appears.

Verify this session has manager-level access, not CEO-only access. Use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/meetings/upcoming — expect 200 with a JSON array (meetings endpoint uses require_manager, so cc_manager can access it). Then use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/agents — expect 403 with detail 'CEO role required' (agents endpoint uses require_ceo, which cc_manager does NOT satisfy). PASS if meetings/upcoming=200 AND agents=403. FAIL if agents returns 200 (account has CEO-level access, not manager-level) or if meetings/upcoming returns 403 (cc_manager role was not correctly granted).

CRITICAL — Save browser session state with cookies. Call the mcp__cctr-playwright__browser_storage_state tool with filename "/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-manager-state.json". After calling the tool, VERIFY the file was correctly saved by using browser_run_code to execute: const fs = require('fs'); const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-manager-state.json', 'utf8')); console.log('cookies:', d.cookies ? d.cookies.length : 0); If the cookies count is 0 (empty state), the primary tool failed — use browser_run_code as the FALLBACK to save actual storage state: const fs = require('fs'); const state = await page.context().storageState(); fs.writeFileSync('/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-manager-state.json', JSON.stringify(state)); console.log('saved cookies:', state.cookies.length); Mark this step FAILED if the final file still has 0 cookies — an empty state file will cause all dependent manager-role leaf journeys to fail.

description: Trunk: portal login as superadmin with ComC grant, verify dashboard loads with 7 pillar nav, save browser state.

steps.description: TRUNK FRESH LOGIN — DO NOT load any browser state file. This journey CREATES the session. Do NOT call browser_set_storage_state. Start fresh: use browser_tabs to close all tabs except the current one. Use browser_evaluate to wipe the service worker cache: 'await caches.keys().then(ks => Promise.all(ks.map(k => caches.delete(k))))'. Then navigate directly to http://localhost:3002/auth/login?t=Date.now() (cache-bust). VERIFY the login form is visible (email+password fields must be present in the snapshot). Fill email 'qa-test-journeyhawk@phronex.com' and password 'HMqt4kH5loXkeAtvQSndQ7zNmow!Phx#9'. Submit and wait for the portal sidebar to appear. Mark failed if redirected to a non-login page before credentials are submitted.

Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/dashboard. Verify the ComC dashboard section loads without a 500 error or blank white screen. The dashboard main area should show stat cards (Org Health, Active Agents, Pending Approvals). Verify NO JavaScript TypeError appears in the browser console — if 'toFixed' or 'Cannot read properties of undefined' appears in console errors, this is a stale browser cache serving the old JS bundle: record the chunk filename from the error and mark the step as failed. Verify the left sidebar shows the Command Centre pillar sections (Pulse, Revenue, People, Operations, Strategy, Intelligence, Config). If the page redirects elsewhere or shows 403/404, flag immediately.

IMPORTANT — Save browser session: Call the mcp__cctr-playwright__browser_storage_state tool with filename set to "/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-superadmin-state.json" to save cookies and localStorage for downstream test nodes. This step is critical — without it, dependent journeys will fail.

description: [BEHAVIORAL] Verify budget allocations are correctly retrieved, isolated by tenant, created/updated with validation, and prevent duplicate or invalid entries.

steps.description: Load saved superadmin session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-superadmin-state.json' using browser_storage_state. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/costs. Verify the page loads without 500 error or blank screen.

Verify the Costs overview page shows cost KPI cards — at minimum one of: 'Budget Utilisation', 'Org Spend', or a department cost breakdown table. The page must render actual content sections (not an empty white box). Take a screenshot.

Use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/costs/budget. PASS if response is 200 with a JSON array (empty array is valid — no budget allocations configured yet). FAIL only on 500, 403, or 404. Record the count of budget entries returned.

Use browser_network_request to POST http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/costs/budget with body {"dept_id": null, "agent_id": null, "period": "monthly", "hard_limit_usd": 50000, "soft_limit_minutes": 600}. PASS if response is 201 with a budget allocation object that includes an 'id' field. FAIL on 500 or 422. Record the returned id.

Use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/costs/budget again. Verify the array now contains the entry created in step 4 (look for the matching id). PASS if the entry appears. This tests that POST correctly persists to the DB and GET reflects the new state.

Navigate away to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/dashboard then back to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/costs. Use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/costs/budget. Verify the entry from step 4 is still present (not lost on page refresh). PASS if id from step 4 is in the response. This tests persistence across navigation.

description: [general] Comc Hld Concurrency Model — Full DEEP journey covering CRUD, validation, and persistence + cross-service integration

steps.description: Load superadmin session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-superadmin-state.json'. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre. Verify the dashboard loads with HTTP 200 and shows organisation widgets. If session expired (redirected to login), re-authenticate as superadmin. FAIL if page returns 500 or shows error state.

Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/departments. Verify the departments list loads. Using the browser_network_request tool, call POST http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/departments with JSON body {"name": "HLD_Concurrency_Test_Dept", "description": "DEEP concurrency test department"}. Verify HTTP 201 response with a returned id and org_id. Capture the department id for subsequent steps.

Using the browser_network_request tool, call POST http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/initiatives with JSON body {"title": "Init_Concurrency_Test", "description": "Concurrency validation initiative", "status": "active"}. Verify HTTP 201 response with initiative_id returned. Then call GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/initiatives and verify the newly created initiative appears in the response array.

VALIDATION: Using browser_network_request, attempt POST http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/departments with an empty JSON body {}. Expect HTTP 422 (Pydantic validation error) with error detail about missing required fields. FAIL if the server returns 500 instead of a proper validation error. A 422 with field-level error messages is the correct response.

PERSISTENCE: Navigate away from departments to http://localhost:3002/command-centre (dashboard). Wait 3 seconds. Navigate back to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/departments. Verify the department created in step 2 ('HLD_Concurrency_Test_Dept') still appears in the list. Click on it to open the detail view. Verify the department name, description, and org_id all match what was submitted. FAIL if the department is missing or data has changed.

CROSS-PILLAR: Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/agents. Verify the agents list loads with HTTP 200. Confirm GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/agents returns a JSON array (may be empty in test env — that is valid). Then navigate back to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/departments to confirm cross-pillar navigation works without session loss or 500 errors. PASS if both pages load cleanly.
